title: Ethics board review of gift guide and gift laws
summary: In November 2024 the Board of Ethics voted six to zero to form a small working group to check whether its gift guide is adequate. The group is to suggest improvements to the gift law.

timeline.text: Motion to form a small working group on the gift guide: The board voted to form a small working group to review its gift guide and suggest changes to gift laws.
A member said a small working group would check if the board's gift guide is adequate and suggest improvements to the law.
